slots.name: settings
slots.about: copied into state: id (1 up, the list order, no gaps: a row's place is its id), head (the section name on a section's first row, else ""), icon, name, kind ("switch" or "choice"), on (switch value), options (choice words, a list of text), pick (choice place in options, 1 up), note (a quiet line under a switch, or ""), parent (0, or the id of a top-level switch that must be on)

slots.name: needs_text
slots.about: the words before the parent's name on a row that is waiting for its parent

slots.name: on_word
slots.about: said for a switch that is on

slots.name: off_word
slots.about: said for a switch that is off

slots.name: changed_line
slots.about: the line over the restore button; may read changed (rows that differ from the start)

slots.name: tap_row
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: a tap on a row flips its switch or moves its choice to the next option; nothing while its parent is off

slots.name: restore
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: every row back to the start

attention.shows: changed_line and the restore button, pinned at the bottom

fallback.shows: a row whose parent is off stays in place at 0.4 with its value replaced by needs_text and the parent's name, and taps do nothing

labels.row_btn: the name, on_word or off_word or the chosen option, and needs_text with the parent's name while waiting

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, smooth, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: a switch's knob moves side as well as colour, and a waiting row says what it needs in words
